name: Breezandal
desc:
Meet 
Vibram FiveFingers Breezandal
, a breathable minimalist shoe designed for outdoor use in warm conditions—combining lightweight construction with airflow-focused comfort and essential protection for outdoor activities.
Designed for trail use, Breezandal features a 
5.7 mm sole
 with 
Vibram Megagrip compound
, engineered for traction on both dry and wet surfaces. It is ideal for environments near rivers, lakes, and wet terrain, supporting stability in changing outdoor conditions.
Integrated into the sole is 
3D Cocoon mesh
, a protective layer designed to disperse impact from small sharp objects such as rocks and debris. This structure maintains underfoot protection while preserving ground feel and natural sensory feedback.
Built to keep feet cool while maintaining terrain connection, Breezandal is suited for warm-weather exploration and water-adjacent environments.
Breezandal is your lightweight minimalist companion for breathable outdoor performance.
Perfect for:
• trail walking and light hiking
• outdoor activities in warm climates
• use near rivers, lakes, and wet terrain
• travel and exploration with a focus on breathability
• users seeking a balance between protection and ground feel
 Details
Usage
• Best suited for trail use, with versatility for water environments and wet conditions
Weight
• W37 = 134 g / 4.7 oz
• M43 = 182 g / 6.4 oz
Sole Specifications
• 3.7 mm rubber outsole for lightweight durability and flexibility
• Insole: 2 mm PU foam + polyester sockliner for added comfort
Upper Material
• Breathable air-mesh upper with G-Hook system for enhanced ventilation and secure fit
Closure System
• Adjustable heel strap with hook-and-loop closure
• Adjustable webbing system for a customizable and secure fit
Protection
• Abrasion-resistant film layer on the toes for increased durability in high-wear areas
Construction
• Lightweight and quick-drying design suitable for both trail and water use
Care Instructions
• Machine wash cold / Air dry
 FAQs
What makes Breezandal unique in the FiveFingers collection?
Breezandal is the most breathable model in the collection, designed to maximize airflow while still providing protection and grip for outdoor use.
Does Breezandal offer reliable grip on wet surfaces?
Breezandal is designed with Vibram Megagrip compound, which is engineered to support traction on a variety of surfaces, including both dry and wet conditions. Performance may vary depending on terrain and usage.
What is the 3D Cocoon and how does it work?
The 3D Cocoon is a thin protective mesh embedded in the sole that disperses the impact of sharp objects like rocks or debris, enhancing protection without reducing ground feel.
Is Breezandal suitable for hot weather?
Yes, its highly breathable design makes it an excellent choice for warm climates and summer outdoor activities.
Can I use Breezandal in water environments?
Yes, it performs well in wet conditions and is a great option for areas near water, though it is not a dedicated water

Max Feel approach,

The breathable stretch synthetic upper conforms to the shape of the foot, providing a secure and comfortable fit during varied activities. Lightweight and flexible, it supports agility, grip, and natural articulation.

• 5 mm total thickness with a segmented construction for enhanced flexibility and natural foot articulation
Compound
• Vibram EcoStep rubber with 30% recycled Vibram content, designed to provide grip and durability
Upper Material
• Breathable, stretchy synthetic upper that wraps the foot for a glove-like fit
Ground Feel
• Max ground feel for maximum sensory feedback and natural movement

• Machine wash cold / Air dry

 Details

Machine wash cold and air dry. Do not use a dryer.

Max Ground Feel means the shoe provides the highest level of sensory feedback, helping improve balance, stability, and overall movement awareness.

desc:
Meet 
Vibram FiveFingers Spidrwalk
, a minimalist outdoor shoe designed for use in wet and variable terrain—developed with a focus on traction, water management, and natural movement, while offering suitable protection for outdoor environments.
Grounded in Vibram’s core 
barefoot philosophy,
 Spidrwalk supports ground feedback while helping provide protection from uneven and wet surfaces. The 
3.7 mm Vibram Megagrip outsole
 is engineered for grip across wet and irregular terrain, including rocks, mud, and riverbeds. It is intended to support control and stability during activities such as creek hiking, stream crossings, and coastal exploration.
The breathable upper is designed to help limit debris entry, while drainage perforations allow water to flow out and support faster drying. Flexible and lightweight, Spidrwalk promotes freedom of movement and a natural feel underfoot.
Built for versatility, Spidrwalk is suitable for use across water and land, enabling smooth transitions between environments.
Spidrwalk is designed for outdoor use where wet terrain and mixed surfaces are present.
Perfect for:
• wet terrain hiking
• amphibious trail use
• minimalist outdoor activities near water
• use in rivers, canyons, and coastal areas
• slippery and rocky terrain
 Details

• M43: 4.6 oz / 130 g

• Insole: Polyester Fabric + 2mm EVA Foam
• Midsole: —

Upper Material
• Stretch Polyester
• TPU Reinforcements

• Machine wash cold
• Air dry only
 FAQs
Can I use Spidrwalk for river crossings or water hiking?
Absolutely. Spidrwalk is designed for wet terrain adventures and drains water quickly while providing excellent grip.
Do they dry fast after being submerged?
Yes. The drainage channels and breathable construction help the shoe dry rapidly as you move.
How is the traction on slippery or mossy surfaces?
The Vibram Megagrip outsole delivers top-tier wet surface traction, perfect for rocks, creek beds, and coastal terrain.

Definitely. Spidrwalk transitions smoothly from water to land, ideal for mixed environment activities.

The upper is engineered to minimize sand, silt, and small debris entry, keeping your movement comfortable.

Yes—Spidrwalk is excellent for paddle sports and any activity requiring grip, agility, and fast drainage.

Yes. You get natural ground feedback with just the right amount of protection for rugged outdoor use.

, a lightweight and breathable minimalist running shoe designed for those transitioning from traditional footwear to a more natural running experience—combining comfort, versatility, and a streamlined design for everyday performance.

desc:

Vibram Furoshik
i, an innovative footwear concept inspired by the ancient Japanese art of wrapping objects in fabric. Designed to provide a personalized fit, it naturally follows the shape of the foot, delivering comfort, flexibility, and convenience for both travel and everyday wear.
As an expression of Vibram’s
 philosophy of innovation and functional design
, Vibram Furoshiki stands out with its unique wrap-around upper that naturally adapts to the shape of the foot. The stretch fabric construction, combined with an adjustable hook-and-loop closure system, ensures a secure, stable, and customizable fit. The Vibram sole technology provides comfort, grip, and stability across a wide variety of surfaces, making this footwear ideal for urban use, travel, and light outdoor activities.
Lightweight and easily packable, Vibram Furoshiki fits effortlessly into luggage, backpacks, or travel bags. Its wrap-around construction promotes a natural freedom of movement throughout the day. Each pair also comes with a convenient travel pouch, ideal for transport and storage.

 ADI Compasso d’Oro Award in 2018 
for its innovative design, Vibram Furoshiki has become a benchmark in contemporary footwear, combining functionality, research, and distinctive style.
Ideal for:
Travel and vacations
Everyday casual wear
Urban walking and daily commuting
Reducing luggage bulk
Light outdoor activities and leisure time

What makes Vibram Furoshiki different from traditional shoes?
Vibram Furoshiki features a unique wrap-around design inspired by the Japanese tradition of wrapping objects in fabric. Its flexible upper adapts to a wide variety of foot shapes, creating a personalized fit.

Yes. Vibram Furoshiki is lightweight, foldable, and easy to pack, making it an ideal travel companion that fits effortlessly into luggage, backpacks, or carry-on bags.

Can I use Vibram Furoshiki for outdoor activities?

What makes Vibram Furoshiki different from traditional shoes?
Vibram Furoshiki features a unique wrap-around design inspired by the Japanese tradition of wrapping objects in fabric. Its flexible upper adapts to a wide variety of foot shapes, creating a personalized fit.
Is Vibram Furoshiki suitable for travel?
Yes. Vibram Furoshiki is lightweight, foldable, and easy to pack, making it an ideal travel companion that fits effortlessly into luggage, backpacks, or carry-on bags.
How does the wrap-around closure system work?
The stretch upper wraps around the foot and secures with a convenient adjustable hook-and-loop closure. This system allows for quick on-and-off wear while ensuring a customized fit.
Can I wear Vibram Furoshiki every day?
Absolutely. Vibram Furoshiki is designed to provide everyday comfort and exceptional versatility, making it ideal for walking, commuting, casual outings, and travel.
Does Vibram Furoshiki provide good grip?
Yes. Equipped with Vibram sole technology, Vibram Furoshiki delivers reliable traction and stability across a variety of urban surfaces and light outdoor terrain.
Is it comfortable for different foot shapes?
Yes. The stretch fabric upper is designed to naturally conform to the foot, accommodating a wide range of foot widths and shapes.

name: Men's Furoshiki EcoFree
desc:
The comfy, stylish Furoshiki ECO FREE is eco-conscious version our popular wrapping sole. Inspired by the Japanese tradition of wrapping, carrying and holding objects, the soft upper fabric wraps comfortably around the foot, and secures snugly for a quick, easy fit. Furoshiki ECO FREE features a durable, flexible Vibram Ecostep Natural outsole that is made with more than 90% natural ingredients. The unique sole coloration comes from 100% natural pigments. In addition, the upper material is made from 90% recycled materials, and features 4 way stretch for a perfect fit. The minimalist footbed is comprised of soft EVA for improved comfort, while the lining yarns include a high percentage of recycled polyester. Wherever you go, when you wrap your feet in Furoshiki ECO FREE, you will arrive in comfort.
 Details
PRODUCT FEATURES
Inspired by the Japanese tradition of wrapping, carrying and holding objects in cloth
Vibram Ecostep Natural outsole, made with more than 90% natural ingredients
Unique sole color derived from 100% natural pigments
Material Construction: 55% recycled nylon; 35% recycled polyester; 10% spandex
Minimal footbed in soft EVA for comfort. Lining yarns made from recycled polyester
Weight: Men’s size 43 = 355g; Women’s size 38 = 293g
Sole Thickness: 3.0mm in the forefront; 3.7mm in the heel
